title: THE DOWNED CARD SELF-REVIVE KEY IS A KEYCAP
why: Critic on the downed screen (P1): self-revive is the primary action but has no key chip. The key now stands on the shared keycap (hudKey), the same chip the prompts and the controls list use, with the words beside it.
now: The downed card shows the self-revive key on a keycap chip.
